name: THE TV STATION
rule: VAMILY rules 416 (the big interiors: the tile stays a house), 461 (more boards), 451(a) (its ceiling at 10%), 59 (every tile its cost and its effect), 428, 441.
facts: A local TV station is a studio (the news set, its backdrop, studio cameras on pedestals, a lighting grid overhead, cable everywhere on the floor) beside a newsroom of desks and a master control room walled in monitors.
A green screen wall stands at one end of the studio; the set's desk is built heavy, to be lit and shot from the front.
On house tiles the studio is the whole board: the set a few tiles across, the cameras and the lights on their stands the cover.
how_to_mod: A layout is 15 strings of 20 characters; every character is in 'legend'; every tile kind a legend entry names has its row in 'tiles' (its cost and its effect). A piece names the finished piece it is drawn as ('like') until this folder has its own art file (tvstation_art.json: floor lists and a kit, the garage's format). slices/bohemia_big_inside.js lays it; slices/fight_ground/insides.json lists the insides.
districts_why: The TV station is its own map kind: eight fights in ten there are fought inside it, by the cell's own dice; the rest round its masts and its lot.
tiles_how: Rule 59: every kind of tile says what it costs to step on and what it does. 'row' is the fight's own ground row (flat 2 AP, rough 3, height +1 a level, obstacles none); 'open' is open floor (on AUTO nobody stays on it); 'good' is ground AUTO goes to; 'say' is the one line he reads when he taps it (draft, the fewest words). [bb] each kind is a Battle Brothers ground: flat, rough, an obstacle, and cover as its trees and walls give it.

wall.effect: The studio's padded wall: no way through, no sight through.

floor.effect: The studio's painted floor, taped with old marks: open ground, nothing to hide behind; on AUTO nobody stays on it.

greenscreen.effect: The green screen wall, its cyclorama curve: nobody stands there; cover beside it. [bb] its wall.

backdrop.effect: The news set's backdrop, the city skyline on it: no way through, no sight through. [bb] its wall.

newsdesk.effect: The news desk, built heavy: cover.

camera.effect: A studio camera on its pedestal: low cover.

lightstand.effect: A light on its stand, its barn doors open: low cover.

prompter.effect: A teleprompter on its cart, its last script frozen on the glass: low cover.

flats.effect: Set flats leaning in a stack: nobody stands there; cover beside them. [bb] its palisade.

cables.effect: Cable runs taped and untaped across the floor: no cover, and slow going (3 AP). [bb] its rough ground.

racks.effect: Equipment racks, dark: nobody stands there; cover beside them. [bb] its wall.

monitors.effect: A wall of monitors in master control, every screen dead: nobody stands there; cover beside it. [bb] its wall.

console.effect: The control console, its faders frozen: cover.

desks.effect: Newsroom desks in their pods: cover.

chairs.effect: Office chairs kicked over in a heap: low cover, and slow going (3 AP). [bb] its brush.
chairs.say: Kicked-over chairs: low cover, slow going.

fire.effect: A fire somebody keeps in a trash can. It burns day and night: a man in its light is seen.
fire.say_lit: A fire: you stand in its light, and they see you.

doors.effect: The studio's sound-lock doors, propped: open ground, and by day the light falls in: a man here is seen.
doors.say_lit: The doors: open ground, and the day is on you.

kit_how: Every piece is drawn AS a finished piece of another kit ('like') until COOK's own picture for it is in tvstation_art.json under the same name: then that picture is used and nothing here changes. 'kind' is what it does in the fight (COVER, LOW_COVER, WALL); 'blocks_move' means nobody stands on its tile.
start_why: NO HIGH GROUND: one floor; the lighting grid overhead is no place to stand on house tiles.

ceiling.how: VAMILY rule 451(a): the studio's lighting grid, its fixtures dead, over the board at this alpha. 'src' is the picture COOK makes; 'have' true the day it is in the folder. Until then the fight draws 'kind' itself, a stand-in (the hospital's grid).
